label: Doctor's tip · Batch cooking
head: Cook once,
eat all week
name: Dr. Michael Klaper
end_cta: Find Dr. Michael Klaper on Vegans Explore

captions.text: Absolutely, big batch cooking is the key
to not driving yourself nuts with the Vegan food thing.
I don't wanna spend all day chopping and cooking.
Get a crockpot, make up a big honker pot
of hearty vegetable, bean, lentil, quinoa soup.
So if you make up a big pot of soup on Sunday night,
eat it Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday.
And Thursday, make up another big pot of soup,
and eat that Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
So you only have to cook, like, twice a week.
